content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of educational qualification certificates (Matric and above) from Gazetted Officer Attested copy of identity proof (AADHAR/PAN) from Gazetted Officer Attested copies of any other relevant document from Gazetted Officer Photograph on the application form

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Panipat Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form (Annexure A) printed in the notice; details and form also on https://panipat.dcourts.gov.in. Attach copies of ID proof, proof of date of birth, educational certificates (Matric and above), experience certificates and other relevant documents, attested by a Gazetted Officer. Submit the application to the office of District Legal Services Authority, ADR Centre, District Courts Complex, Panipat. Application must reach by 11.12.2026 till 05:00 PM; late applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Panipat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Panipat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for General Counsellor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA Panipat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Form (Annexure A), pages 5-6 of this PDF; also on https://panipat.dcourts.gov.in) and send it to District Legal Services Authority, ADR Centre, District Courts Complex, Panipat, by submission in the office of dlsa; the notice refers to postal/courier services and is not responsible for their delay, to reach by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 62 years (as on the last date of receipt of application). Relaxation: Deserving candidate Upper age limit may be relaxed by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium Rs. 2,000 per sitting, subject to 30 sittings per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Sociology/Psychology. Preference to law graduates with requisite experience of working with NGOs and in the field of child and matrimonial counseling.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview/interaction. Selection on the basis of interview/interaction. Knowledge, experience and expertise in relevant field assessed during the interview/interaction. The State Authority reserves the right to shortlist applications on criteria fixed by the Authority.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement purely on contractual basis. May be extended or terminated as per guidelines. Honorarium paid per sitting, subject to 30 sittings per month.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Mediation & Conciliation Centre, District Legal Services Authority, Panipat.
